title: I think I was in the mall world bathrooms the last two nights?
content: The last two nights I've visited this bathroom that was connected to this school and it was kind of dirty, more grimey, and there was rows of brown stalls on each side with dirty dingey white tiles everywhere. There were randomly open showers in-between the stalls and I kept seeing people though no one really acknowledged each other. It was kind of dimly lit, like school flouresant lights that where dimmed or just not working and there seemed to be no end to the rows of stalls. I didn't think this had anything to do with mall world until I saw a video of someone showing what they saw and mentioned the bathrooms in the school which surprised me. Last night in my dream I did make eye contact with this girl. She looked young, maybe teenager to young adult with a short-medium length, dense afro and a long thin face. I almost think she was a teenager because she was very thin and had an almost wide eyed look to her like it startled her that we made eye contact for a second as she stood in one of the thinner bathroom stalls. Usually my recurring dreams are on these warped beaches or houses that seem to go on forever, sometimes I end up at the same empty pond or an open part of the mountains, but never really this place. This felt more odd
